source_snapshot.items: Boot Time PPR with Uncorrectable Error
source_snapshot.procedure: Configure Soft PPR, Force-PPR-UCE and fast boot; inject one UCE at0x0, go, observe attributable automatic reset, same-row qualification/PPR request and passed PprRepairStatus.
source_snapshot.criteria: Serial proves PPR acted on the UC error and repair status passed.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic logs omit automatic reset continuity and same-row repair.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Restores one-UCE/reset/boot PPR sequence and recovery gates.

old_problem: Address0x0 target semantics, UCE/reset signature, Force-PPR and fast-boot mappings, same-row serial decoder and crash/OOB recovery require Intel/project approval.
disposition_reason: ED-16 and ED-18 do not permit guessing a fatal injection target or treating any reboot as success. The automatic reset must be attributed to the single UCE and the identical qualified row must reach a passed PprRepairStatus after a complete OFF/boot path defined by the platform owner.
decision_basis: Read all18 XLSX cells and history2545; retained unique identity.
Preserved exact one UCE at0x0, go, automatic reset, row qualification, DDR PPR request, fast-boot behavior and passed status.
Separated this UCE-driven reset from row160 two-CE threshold PPR and row162 runtime PPR.
No injection, reset, BIOS change or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: GNR single-UCE automatic-reset boot-time Soft PPR
test_case.purpose: Prove one mapped UCE causes the expected attributable reset and repairs that same DRAM row through boot-time Soft PPR.
required_package: Approved Intel CScripts/FAE and exact0x0 row mapping
Expected UCE MCA/reset and same-row serial PPR decoder
Dedicated SUT and owner-approved crash recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator captures immutable target/settings/log baseline, performs one approved halt/resetInjector/injectMemError(0x0,errType="uce")/go sequence, continuously records the automatic reset and boot, correlates the same qualified row, DDR PPR request, fast-boot state, repair action and passed status, then restores settings and verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: The single mapped UCE produces the approved signature and one attributable automatic reset; firmware qualifies and repairs that same row, reports passed PprRepairStatus, and returns the SUT healthy with settings restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/harness identity, one UCE, continuous reset/boot evidence, same-row qualification/request/action/passed status, OS-ready health and full restoration. Wrong severity/row, unrelated or repeated reset, missing status, hang or recovery failure fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Dedicated isolated SUT and explicit critical injection authorization.
Do not assume address0x0 is safe or infer its row mapping.
Continuous independent OOB capture before go; stop without reinjection.
No blanket log clear, automatic reboot or retry.
expected_evidence: Single UCE transcript and decoded MCA
test_case.recovery: If reset does not occur as specified, repeats, targets the wrong row or does not reach OS ready, preserve evidence and use only approved OOB/BIOS recovery; never reinject automatically, then restore every temporary setting.

source_conflict.reason: UCE injection, expected reset and post-boot same-row repair form one coherent path.

blocked.reason: Operation is explicit; target, harness, firmware oracle and recovery are supplyable critical prerequisites.
